purpose: Immutable reference for all remediation work on this branch; no claim here describes post-freeze behavior.
rule: The frozen main commit/tree remains the audit reference. Remediation commits on this branch must not be treated as evidence about the frozen state.
initial_findings: Tier 1 is CPU-only; GPUBackend is intentionally blocked.
Benchmark artifacts are internally inconsistent and contain unsupported broad performance claims.
spectral_analysis has an FFT/PSD normalization and odd-length endpoint correctness risk.
convolution accepts stride but does not apply it.
Public metadata and README contain placeholder repository/contact/domain values.
Numerical correctness must be established before performance optimization claims are retained.
